about: Routing eval: given skill descriptions, project rules and a request, the model names the skill that should handle it, or none. Competitor descriptions are short paraphrases of neighbouring sets that trigger on the same requests.

competitors.brainstorming: Use before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality or modifying behavior. Explores intent, requirements and design before implementation.
competitors.writing-plans: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code.
competitors.openspec-new-change: Start a new OpenSpec change for a feature, fix or modification with a step-by-step artifact workflow.
competitors.write-spec: Write a feature spec or PRD from a problem statement or feature idea.
competitors.grilling: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision or idea to stress-test their thinking.
competitors.code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs at a given effort level.
